title: Scientific computing in the age of agentic AI
summary: A new field report shows how scientists use AI coding agents to modernize scientific computing, accelerating software development and discovery in genomics and beyond.
body: A new field report shows how scientists use AI coding agents to modernize scientific computing, accelerating software development and discovery in genomics and beyond.
summaryZh: 最新发布的实地报告展示了科学家们如何利用AI编程智能体来现代化科学计算。这些智能体显著加速了软件开发进程，并在基因组学及其他前沿科研领域推动了重大科学发现的落地。原始信息显示：A new field report shows how scientists use AI coding agents to modernize scientific computing, accelerating software development and discovery in genomics and beyond.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Scientific computing in the age of agentic AI”。其重要性主要体现在：探讨了科学计算领域如何借助AI编码智能体加速软件开发和基因组学等科研发现，属于典型应用场景报告。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
